items.title: AI-Designed Proteins Take on Deadly Snake Venom
items.summary: 100K+ deaths every year from venomous snakebites worldwide 300K severe injuries annually amputations, paralysis, permanent disability Every year, venomous snakes kill over 100,000 people and leave 300,000 more with devastating injuries — amputations, paralysis and permanent disabilities. The victims are often farmers, herders and children in rural communities across sub-Saharan Africa, South Asia and Latin America. F
items.summaryZh: 华盛顿大学David Baker实验室的研究人员利用NVIDIA GPU和深度学习模型（如RFdiffusion和ProteinMPNN），在计算机模拟中生成并测试了能够中和致命蛇毒的合成蛋白质，显著加速了抗毒素研发进程。
